mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the civilian labor force (PAYEMS) signals labor market expansion, which boosts earnings growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising labor force participation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening household demand, which boosts earnings growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
